issues.description: The supplied programs consume the FAME UK panel, Zephyr M&A acquirer/haven panels, country macro and regulation panels, and Orbis municipality-share file without a complete producer/export contract. The primary file names and consumer fields are recorded in linked requirements; no producer or compatible complete source route is confirmed for the missing panels.

The active Buyouts consumers read the formatted full ownership panel from $form; country, European, and municipality-share ownership products have separate active consumers. The raw full-panel step at lines 405-408 is a commented conditional preparation route, not an additional mandatory input. The active field lists are known, but datasheet history of 2005-2018 is not a complete population/history contract and parent links, grouping, hierarchy history, and share definitions remain unresolved. Prepared and raw routes are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.

Official public pages and search snippets identify candidate German directory, regional-account, municipal-finance, debt, personnel, registration, and insolvency products, but do not verify all author workbook schemas, county/municipality populations, years, category definitions, or revisions. The author offers raw administrative data in code format on request; candidate routes remain unverified.

Six supplied programs place global-root assignments inside block comments, so a host-visible relative root map must be configured in a working copy. Spillovers reads two literal Windows W-drive paths: orbis_<country>.dta, produced by PE_Financials, and orbis_<country>_munshares.dta, a separate R_ORBIS_MUNSHARES input with no supplied producer. Root portability for both paths is routine preparation, but configuring the second path does not supply the missing municipality-share product; it must be independently supplied and verified before use. PE_Financials also has a Windows-style shell cleanup command, which needs host adaptation within its existing target scope. No new data or author approval is required solely for portable path setup.

Six supplied program locations contain a bare literal asdf command. One exact Stata which lookup did not find a command named asdf, but the namespace, placeholder intent, and whether any location is operative remain unknown. Preserve every location and do not remove or replace it without author clarification.

The municipal GDP workbook label states 2000-2018, while the supplied year-marker loop is 2000/2017. The exact source-year mapping and whether a 2018 observation is present are unresolved; keep the supplied loop unchanged pending clarification.

The frozen checklist and static trace retain all supplied branches, but mandatory original inputs are absent or lack exact producer/source contracts. Full closure remains incomplete until linked data, ownership history/construction, and producer gaps are resolved. The known root/path handoffs are routine preparation separately represented by I_PATH_SETUP.

evidence.description: The included README identifies the author pair, journal year, and title wording.
evidence.quote:
*** Private Equity and Local Public Finances ***
		by Marcel Olbert & Peter Severin  
		(Journal of Accounting Research, 2023)

evidence.description: The README lists four separate analysis programs for firm, spillover, municipal, and county results.
evidence.quote:
I: Codes for final analyses generating results reported in the paper
	*I.a. The Stata code "Firms_Taxes_Analysis.do" 
		- creates the final firm-level dataset
		- performs analysis with results shown in Section 3 of the paper
	*I.b. The Stata code "Spillovers_Aggregate_Analysis.do" 
		- creates the dataset based on firm-level information aggregated by municipality-year for European countries
		- performs analysis with tabulated regression results shown in Section 4 of the paper
	*I.c. The Stata code "Municipals_Taxes_Analysis.do" 
		- creates the German municipality-level dataset after merging municipality-level public financa data with German PE deals based on location (via firm information from Orbis)
		- performs analysis with tabulated regression results shown in Section 5 of the paper (for municipality-level outcomes)
	*I.d. The Stata code "Counties_Taxes_Analysis.do" 
		- creates the German county-level dataset after merging county-level public financa data with German PE deals based on location (via firm information from Orbis)
		- performs analysis with tabulated regression results shown in Section 5 of the paper (for municipality-level outcomes)

evidence.description: The README links the preparation programs to the analysis programs and names their prepared outputs.
evidence.quote:
II: Codes for taking raw data to final datasets used in I.
	*II.a. The Stata code "Buyouts_Formatting.do" imports and cleans PE deals obtained from Zephyr (see notes on raw data in III. below)
	*II.b. The Stata code "PE_Financials.do" 
		- imports panel data on firm-level financial accounting data from Orbis
		- creates firm-level financial variables
		- merges Orbis financial data to PE target firms from II.a
		- contains the 1-1 nearest neighbor matching algorithm as described in the Online Appendix
	*II.c. The Stata code "Municipals_Formatting.do" imports and cleans several raw administrative municipality-level datasets from the German Statistical Office, leading to the "Gemeindedaten_county.dta", "Gemeindedaten_postcode.dta", and "Gemeindedaten_municipal.dta" datasets, used in I.c. above 
	*II.d. The Stata code "Counties_Formatting.do"  imports and cleans several raw administrative county-level aggregate datasets from the German Statistical Office, leading to the "Kreise Final 2000-2019.dta" dataset, used in I.d. above

evidence.description: The supplied Zephyr file is an identifier list tied to a dated PE search, not a full analysis panel.
evidence.quote:
III: Identifiers of observations used in analyses
	*III.a.	The file "zephyr_privateequity_dealids.txt" contains the full list of Bureau van Dijk (BvD) 
		deal identifiers and target firm BvD identifiers used in the paper. These identifiers stem from observations
		available in the Zephyr database as of 28/12/2020 when applying the following search steps:
		1. Time period: on and after 01/01/1990 and up to and including 31/12/2019 (rumoured, completed-confirmed, completed-assumed, announced)	
		2. Deal type: Private equity	
		The Stata code "Buyouts_Formatting.do" (see II.a above) cleans the raw data and also saves the list of identifiers.
	*III.b.	The file "zephyr_privateequity_dealids.txt" contains the list of Bureau van Dijk (BvD) identifiers of target firms and matched control firms used in the firm-level tests (Section 3) of the paper

evidence.description: The README describes public-source local-finance data and says authors will share the raw data in the code format on request.
evidence.quote:
IV: Availability of administrative data on local public finances
The raw data used in analyses of Sections 4 and 5 of the paper are publicly available from the sources described in the paper.
The authors will share the raw data as of the download date and in the format used in Codes I.c and I.d in their paper upon request.

evidence.description: The datasheet identifies commercial Orbis/Zephyr products and public German administrative data.
evidence.quote:
We access three different products of the Orbis database provided by BvD:

   1. We download Private Equity and European M&A Deals BvD’s Online database which
      we accessed between 27 and 31 December 2020. Data on global M&A deals were
      retrieved on 21 January 2021
   2. We access historical versions of the Orbis database for the years 2005 to 2018 to link
      these unique firms to their global subsidiaries in an iterative process through their
      hierarchical ownership chain.
   3. We use financial statement information. We download this information from the Orbis
      Generics Update as of July 2020.

We detail the sample construction process for the firm-level deal sample in Section 2. We use the
same firm-level data for creating aggregate information and detail the process in Section 4.

For the municipality-level and county-level tests, we use publicly available administrative data
on local tax revenues in Germany. These data are available at the German statistical office. We
detail the data sources and data collection procedure in Sections 2 and 5.1.

	sort bvd year
	
	*Rename variables

	rename country_alpha2 country
	
	*Select variables

	order $variables

		keep(master matched) keepusing(group_firms group_international) nogen

evidence.description: Municipal formatter constructs postcode and county lookup panels from the 2010 Gemeindedaten sheet.
evidence.quote:
import excel "$orig/31122010_Auszug_GV.xlsx", sheet("Gemeindedaten") clear
keep C D E F G H I J N

gen year = 2010
gen municipal_id = C + D + E + G
drop C D E F G
rename H municipal
rename N postcode
rename I area
rename J population

drop if postcode == ""
drop if municipal == "Gemeindename"
replace municipal = subinstr(municipal, " ", "", .)
destring postcode area population, replace

compress
save "$form/Postcodes_2010.dta", replace

evidence.description: Municipal GDP input mapping and year-construction range.
evidence.quote:
import excel "$orig/GDP 2000-2018.xlsx", clear
rename A municipal_id
rename B municipal
rename C gdp_total 
label var gdp_total "Local GDP (th EUR)"
rename D gdp_worker
rename E gdp_capita 
drop F - M

drop if municipal_id=="" & municipal==""
gen year=.
forval yr = 2000/2017 {
replace year=`yr' if municipal_id=="`yr'" & municipal==""
}
tab year
replace year = year[_n-1] if year==.

actions.description: Confirm and acquire compatible Zephyr PE Results exports and the distinct Zephyr M&A input through an actually available product route. Preserve the four PE result sheets and documented author fields; do not treat the identifier list as an analysis panel.
steps: Confirm whether the required Zephyr PE and M&A product tables are available in the user's permitted environment; the local catalog scan did not verify a compatible candidate or access.
For the PE branch, obtain the four Results-sheet exports required by Buyouts_Formatting.do and check the raw deal, target, acquirer, vendor, status, and date fields against the code mappings.
For the M&A branch, identify a compatible Zephyr M&A transaction export for the expected deal_id, bvd, and year transformation; retain its source population and period as a separate contract.
Place compatible source files in the package-relative original-data location in a writable working copy, retaining the supplied search list as provenance only.
validation: Before any authorized run, use bounded metadata inspection to confirm sheet names, required columns, identifier types, and period coverage.
After authorization, compare formatter-created deal outputs with the consumed names and fields without changing the supplied sample rules.

actions.description: Resolve the missing producers for the acquirer-year deal and haven panels. Use compatible author-prepared files or a specified raw-source transformation as alternatives; do not require both routes.
steps: Obtain the exact author-prepared zephyr_manda_acquirors.dta and zephyr_manda_acquirors_havens.dta contracts, or obtain the complete source-to-panel transformation and its required inputs.
Confirm the transaction/acquirer universe, country and year coverage, deal_manda/deal_manda_local/deal_haven definitions, and bvd_acquiror-year join keys.
Select one compatible route for each consumed panel; raw Zephyr inputs are conditional reconstruction sources and are not an additional mandatory AND requirement while prepared panels suffice.
validation: Use bounded metadata inspection to verify bvd_acquiror and year keys and all three fields retained by the firm-analysis merges.
After authorization, confirm producer output names and consumer merge keys before the firm analysis stage.

actions.description: Confirm an available Orbis financial-statement route and export the country files in the format consumed by PE_Financials.do.
steps: Confirm a permitted local BvD Orbis product route and the country/year coverage; catalog metadata did not verify a compatible local table or entitlement.
Export the documented financial statement fields and raw bvdid/country_alpha2 identifiers required by the supplied import and normalization steps.
Retain the code's accounting filters and build each orbis_eur_<country>.txt in the expected original-data location after field mapping is confirmed.
validation: Use bounded file metadata checks for encoding, delimiter, field names, identifiers, and 1997-2020 observation coverage before any author program is run.
